claims.claimText: The UNEP IMEO MARS snapshot records a methane plume linked to KAZ_S_159 at 2026-07-11T08:12:14.
claims.rationale: The supplied record explicitly links this dated plume to the source; this asserts the snapshot record, not current emissions.

claims.claimText: By 2026-09-23, the operator of KAZ_S_159 had received a notification about the plume observed at 2026-07-11T08:12:14.
claims.rationale: Source-level notified/feedback flags and a link-only report title do not supply recipient delivery evidence or an inspected post-action method/result. Missing later observations do not prove zero methane.

claims.claimText: By 2026-09-23, mitigation at KAZ_S_159 had been physically confirmed using a post-action methane measurement.
claims.rationale: Source-level notified/feedback flags and a link-only report title do not supply recipient delivery evidence or an inspected post-action method/result. Missing later observations do not prove zero methane.
